_meta.purpose: Prohibited qualifier words for the net-quantity declaration, read by rules_engine.forbidden_qualifiers() and matched case-insensitively with word boundaries against the OCR-read net-quantity line (CHK05, ledger L-01). The net quantity must be stated in the prescribed unit as a plain figure, without any word that qualifies, hedges, or averages it.
_meta.matching: Each word is tested as re.search(r'\b<word>\b', line.lower()); keep entries lowercase. Symbols without word boundaries (e.g. plus-minus) are not listed because \b cannot anchor them.
